items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oh, Czerny, a lot of Czerny and a lot of Hanon... I still practice Czerny

ctx.x: I’d like to know—what do you use to warm yourself up and get your fingers ready to play when you haven’t played for a while?
Oh, Czerny, a lot of Czerny and a lot of Hanon, the Italian version of Hanon.
